question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"caused"** means to make something happen, especially something bad. (कारण बनना)
 
• Famines were caused during the period of British rule due to many reasons. (अनेक कारणों से ब्रिटिश शासन के दौरान अकाल कारण बने थे)
 
• Therefore, the correct choice should imply bringing about the famine, which makes "caused" the correct word.

Therefore, the correct answer is **caused**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings:

 
• **Paused** (विराम): Temporary stop or break.

 
 
• **Example:** The movie was paused at an interesting scene.
 
 
 
• **Excruciated** (यातनाग्रस्त): To inflict severe pain or suffering upon.
 
 
• **Example:** The wound excruciated him to the point of tears.
 
 
 
• **Discouraged** (हतोत्साहित): Having lost confidence or enthusiasm.
 
 
• **Example:** The athlete felt discouraged after not making the team.
 
 

42:Tc48,

The correct answer is: **Option 3.**
